natural_language_statement: Every numbered card from 320 through 383 of the fixed 21-move certificate is a valid conditional claim. The required set, envelope and height are the literal finite reconstruction of the printed data, including every nested combination. Every actual combination equation is checked by Lean kernel reduction, and the game meaning follows from the conditional-claim calculus and earlier numbered cards.
explanation: Each placed reference preserves validity. Every nested and numbered combination is reconstructed independently from the literal required sets, envelopes and heights; its three field equations are proved by kernel computation. Applying Lemma 3 then proves the corresponding conditional claim. Only earlier numbered claims are used. The final conjunction packages all numbered claims in this block for the next block.
